news.body:
## What moved
- You closed the CareerLeader and Career Anchors questionnaires on 18 October.
- You wrote to Campus France New Delhi on the 21st, copying Fitria in Jakarta. That was the one thing the dossier transfer was waiting on.
- INSEAD agreed on the 20th to take the 53,000 euro instalment as a direct bank transfer from your Indian bank.
- The SBI sanction moved to 10 November once it was clear the documents have to be signed at your Indian branch, not in Jakarta.

## What did not
- The board has recorded no change since 19 October. Six days.
- CareerGlobe is dated the 27th and is now the only thing standing between you and booking your first CDC coaching session.
- InCorp's revised quotation has been unanswered since the 12th.
- The four internship applications, the post-MBA statement and the LMS tutorials are all untouched.

## Risks
- The visa is entirely out of your hands and the clock is not. Campus France Delhi has not replied since you wrote on the 21st, and if they are still silent at the end of this week you fly on 4 November with the dossier still in Jakarta. There is nothing to do but chase, which is why it is worth chasing early rather than waiting politely.
- Your first week in India carries almost everything at once. You land on the 4th, your KITAS expires on the 8th, all four applications close on the 8th, and the SBI documents are dated the 10th. Any one of those slipping is survivable; all four landing in the same week in a country you have just moved to is the real exposure.
- The KITAS is the one with no route back. The renewal window closed while the quotation sat, so cancellation is the only option left, and the BPJS claim runs through the same people.
- The money is the one risk that got smaller. With INSEAD taking a direct transfer, the 5 November instalment no longer waits on the loan landing first.

## Put first this week
- One line to InCorp confirming the cancellation. It is the shortest thing on the list and the one with the hardest deadline behind it.
- CareerGlobe, an hour, which unblocks the coaching booking.
- Chase Delhi if nothing has arrived by Tuesday, and copy Fitria again so Jakarta can see you are pushing.
